logs.text: Manifest system online. Crew: forty-one. Cargo: survey drones, rations, hope.
Pathfinder orders: chart the Drift relays. Do not linger.
Relay Kestrel-Nine answered our hail. Nobody aboard sent it.
Captain Oyelaran ordered the holds sealed. I sealed them.
The Murmur hums below hearing. Crates rattle when it passes.
Crew departed by lifeboat. Manifest updated: crew, zero.
Eleven years powered down. I counted dust. Dust won.

logs.unlock: all other logs read, during Graveyard Watch
logs.text: New signature aboard: one engineer. Manifest updated: crew, one.
